Stay focused with real-time transcription and summaries,

mock.transcript: Today we'll cover the Transformer, the model that revolutionized how AI understands language. Earlier RNN- and CNN-based models relied on sequential computation, which made parallelization difficult. The Transformer replaces this entirely with self-attention, capturing relationships between all words in a sentence at once and enabling much faster, more efficient training...
mock.summary: The Transformer is a self-attention architecture that replaced RNNs and CNNs, improving both parallel computation and context understanding, and became the core of modern language models.

summary.desc: Follow the lecture as it happens. Understand everything with real-time summaries.
summary.point3: An organized learning history based on speech recognition

qna.title: AI Q&A
qna.desc:
AI thinks of the questions you're likely to have.
It suggests questions based on the lecture context and answers them right away.
qna.point1: See questions and answers instantly, no prompts needed
qna.point2: Explanations from multiple angles to organize and deepen understanding
qna.sampleQ1: Why is the Transformer said to be faster than RNNs?
qna.sampleA1: Instead of processing words one by one, the Transformer computes the relationships between all words in parallel...
qna.sampleA2: Because the Transformer doesn't process words in order, position information has to be provided separately...
